---
title: "Teaching"
---

::: {.intro}
My teaching focuses on applied machine learning. In particular, I am interested in teaching topics in these areas to students with diverse backgrounds so that they can apply them in their own disciplines. To effectively serve this target audience, one of my goals has been making complex concepts more approachable and less intimidating without losing their depth or rigour.

- Check out my [teaching statement](teaching-statement.html)
- Check out my [@appliedmachinelearningubc YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC40oUwJPrUmhsYdURk8OjqA), where I share introductory videos on applied machine learning.
:::
